# KRADIND Adventures

> India's premier certified high-altitude expedition operator. Specializing in small-batch eco-treks, Himalayan alpine circuits, and tailored experiential travel with certified wilderness leaders.

KRADIND Adventures is a government-recognized, certified adventure travel organization headquartered in Uttarakhand, India with base camp operations in Dehradun, Manali, and Srinagar. We operate certified alpine treks, sacred Himalayan pilgrimages (yatras), tropical coastal journeys, and cultural tours with strict Leave No Trace (LNT) ethics and certified Wilderness First Aid (WFA) leaders.

## Core Navigation & Destinations

- [Himalayan Treks](https://kradind.com/treks): High-altitude alpine treks across Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Ladakh, and Kashmir.
- [Domestic Tours](https://kradind.com/treks/category/domestic): Experiential cultural and nature itineraries across Rajasthan, Kerala, Northeast India, and Goa.
- [Uttarakhand Expeditions](https://kradind.com/treks/category/uttarakhand): Summit treks including Kedarkantha, Chopta Tungnath Chandrashila, Dayara Bugyal, and Kuari Pass.
- [Himachal Circuits](https://kradind.com/treks/category/himachal): Hampta Pass crossover, Kheerganga, Bhrigu Lake, and Pin Parvati pass circuits.
- [Ladakh & Kashmir Passes](https://kradind.com/treks/category/ladakh): Kashmir Great Lakes, Tarsar Marsar, and Leh Ladakh high-altitude routes.
- [Live Trail Radar](https://kradind.com/#live-radar): Real-time weather, trail condition, and pass safety updates updated daily from basecamps.
- [About KRADIND](https://kradind.com/about): Our certified mountaineering team, safety protocols, and eco-initiatives.
- [Contact & 24/7 Helpline](https://kradind.com/contact): Direct assistance for bookings, private departures, and emergency ground desk.

## Signature Pilgrimages & Tour Packages

- [Kedarnath Dham Tour Package](https://kradind.com/lp/kedarnath-tour-package): Premium spiritual expedition with VIP darshan and medical backup.
- [Char Dham Yatra Package](https://kradind.com/lp/char-dham-yatra-package): Comprehensive 10-day sacred circuit covering Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath.
- [Do Dham Yatra Package](https://kradind.com/lp/do-dham-yatra-package): Seamless 6-day pilgrimage to Kedarnath and Badrinath.
- [Kedarkantha Winter Summit](https://kradind.com/lp/kedarkantha-winter-summit): Winter snow summit trek with 360-degree Himalayan views (12,500 ft).
- [Kashmir Great Lakes](https://kradind.com/lp/kashmir-great-lakes): High alpine crossover passing seven turquoise glacial tarns.

## Safety Protocols & Certifications

- **Wilderness First Aid (WFA)**: Every batch is escorted by certified mountaineers carrying pulse oximeters, portable hyperbaric kits, and emergency oxygen.
- **Leave No Trace (LNT)**: Eco-conscious alpine expeditions adhering strictly to zero-waste trail conservation.
- **Small Batches**: Maximum 12 to 15 trekkers per batch for optimal safety and personalized guiding.
